title: One Time first-party CRM and scoped inbox UI

reasons: The source explicitly requests a professional first-party CRM and scoped One Time Inbox.
The current audit and REQ-106 smoke prove the API-backed workbench is present but still needs a CRM/inbox experience layer.
The work is app-visible and requires screenshots, state matrix, registry coverage, and no-send/read-only gates.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Live email/WhatsApp sends remain outside this packet and require exact approval plus REQ-20260712-112 release proof.
recommended_packet_sequence: patch three-pane CRM/inbox layout and safe action states
extend local CRM smoke for desktop/mobile state proof
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: Implement REQ-20260712-107 only; do not modify portal IA, landing WhatsApp, bundle delivery, deploy, or external sends.

operator_intent_summary: Make One Time CRM and Inbox feel like a first-party operator workspace: contact list, conversation/activity, profile, notes/tasks/safe-send affordances, mobile selected-contact flow, scoped inbox context, and read-only view-as parity.
raw_quotes: Build a professional first-party One Time CRM with desktop three-pane list/conversation/profile, mobile list-to-detail flow, tabs, notes, tasks, profile fields, valid Rabbi updates, and read-only view-as disabled writes.

Create a scoped One Time Inbox with thread list, active conversation, contact context, filters, One Time-only workspace behavior, selected-contact retention, replies updating timeline, internal-note separation, and provider/channel audit metadata.

decisions_captured.decision: Original source screenshots are unavailable locally, so regenerated audit and smoke screenshots are the implementation baseline.

out_of_scope: No live email, WhatsApp, payment, access grant, DNS, provider-account, production-data, GHL, LeadConnector, or external CRM writes.
No portal IA, landing WhatsApp launcher, bundle split/minification, or deployment work.
No broad CRM backend changes beyond UI consumption of existing scoped list/detail endpoints.
No claim of production Done before commit/push/deploy/live smoke in REQ-20260712-112.
affected_surfaces: Operations One Time scoped email inbox

inspected: REQ-106 added scoped API-backed CRM loading, list cap, abort/debounce, split shell parity, and local smoke coverage.
The CRM detail currently combines profile fields and timeline in one right column instead of desktop list/conversation/profile panes.
The email workspace has BNA/Rabbi scope switching and Resend readiness gates, but the UI does not yet read as a scoped One Time inbox tied to the selected CRM context.
One Time CSS already contains route-specific email rules that can be extended without inventing a new visual system.
known_gaps: Desktop CRM is not yet a three-pane operator layout.
Mobile selection is stacked but not an explicit list-to-detail/back flow.
CRM safe reply/note/task controls are not represented as first-class action states.
Inbox does not surface selected contact retention or One Time scope as strongly as the CRM acceptance criteria require.

expanded_phrases.CRM: For this packet, CRM means the first-party One Time Operations contact workspace: scoped list, selected activity/conversation, profile, notes/tasks affordances, and safe inbox context only.
expanded_phrases.professional: Dense, scan-friendly operator layout with stable panes, readable labels, bounded actions, and no decorative marketing composition.
expanded_phrases.first-party CRM: Local BNA CRM records scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class, not GHL or LeadConnector.
expanded_phrases.scoped inbox: Email workspace defaults to the Rabbi/One Time scope, shows provider/project metadata, and prevents BNA school-only records from mixing into One Time work.
expanded_phrases.valid updates: Visible notes/tasks/reply affordances must be either connected to existing approved local write paths or explicitly disabled with the blocker; live sends are not valid in this packet.
expanded_phrases.read-only view-as: Signed/project-scoped preview sessions see the same layout with mutation/send controls disabled and labeled read-only preview.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use existing Operations cards, focus panels, status chips, and One Time CSS. Do not add a new CRM runtime, marketing hero, or external-provider workflow.

requirements.title: Build scoped first-party One Time CRM and Inbox experience
acceptance_criteria: Desktop uses left contact list, center activity/conversation, right profile.
Mobile uses contact list to full-screen selected contact to back flow.
Inbox stays scoped to One Time and retains selected contact context.
View-as displays same UI with mutation/send controls disabled and labeled read-only preview.
Action registry and screenshots cover visible controls.

criteria: REQ-20260712-102 current-state audit is Done with regenerated evidence.
REQ-20260712-105 scoped CRM API is Done locally.
REQ-20260712-106 scoped CRM loader/performance behavior is Done locally.

No external sends/writes are in scope.

loading.aria_semantic_expectation: CRM panel remains labeled while loading.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading state is text-visible and not color-only.

empty.expected_visible_message: No CRM contacts match this workspace/filter.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state is announced in the CRM panel.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Empty text is readable at desktop and tablet widths.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Smoke may skip direct empty screenshot if populated proof passes and blocker is recorded.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Load synthetic One Time CRM records.
populated.expected_visible_message: Left contact list, center activity/conversation, and right profile are visible.

findings.user_impact: Mobile users need a clear selected-contact mode instead of scrolling through list/detail/profile as one long page.
findings.expected_fix: Hide the list after mobile selection, show selected activity/profile panes, and provide Back to contacts.

requirements: Back to contacts is a real button.
Disabled send/note/task controls include visible status and title text.
Email inbox scope controls show selected state without color-only reliance.
No text overlaps or horizontal overflow at 390, 430, 768, 1024, and 1440 widths.
